notes: Requires Python >=3.10. Installed distribution version is asserted using importlib.metadata.version.

Every profile/case call clears os.environ, installs exactly case.environment (default {}), and restores the prior environment in finally. No inherited PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED is retained; if explicitly present in case.environment it remains part of the controlled input.
Every stream is a fresh io.StringIO(source), with default newline='\n': supplied CR and CRLF spelling is retained. Streams are text, not bytes.

The file profile writes exact UTF-8 source bytes to a synthetic temporary file and passes its explicit path. Upstream open(encoding='utf-8') uses newline=None universal-newline translation. No dotenv path discovery is used.

Bare keys yield Python None (JSON null) in binding and values observations. load_dotenv skips None values, but its boolean can still be true for a nonempty bare-only mapping or when all assignments were skipped.
Values observations are final maps, not ordered declarations; duplicate keys collapse. Only the bindings array preserves every yielded binding in order, including blank/comment and error bindings.

Binding diagnostics expose only error boolean and original starting line/source chunk, not code, reason, severity, span or stable message identity. Original strings are consumed chunks, not raw-value tokens; upstream strips one leading BOM.
High-level APIs log and omit invalid bindings, without returning diagnostics. Their logger is disabled and restored with a context manager; warning prose is not recorded.

Loading records an actual ValueError from the process-environment API by exception class only, with loaded:null and the resulting possibly partially mutated environment. Adapter/programming exceptions are not swallowed.

Resolved values consult the exact controlled environment without mutating it. Resolved loading combines interpolation and assignment; override controls both lookup precedence and environment assignment.

Wheel integrity and reviewed source commit are separate provenance claims; PyPI metadata does not cryptographically attest the wheel-to-commit relationship. Environment behavior is platform-dependent.
